eyebrow: Three decisions before the VM exists

steps.label: Subnet
steps.sub: the internal app subnet, 10.20.1.0/24 — not the public one

steps.label: NSG rule
steps.sub: allow TCP 22, scoped to the office range, not 0.0.0.0/0

steps.label: SSH key pair
steps.sub: generated locally — no password exists to leak

eyebrow: Generate the key, then create the VM
code:
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/briarcliff-app01

az vm create \
  --name app01 --subnet app \
  --image Ubuntu2204 \
  --ssh-key-values ~/.ssh/briarcliff-app01.pub
caption: The public key is installed at boot — password auth for SSH stays disabled.
The private key, the matching NSG rule, and a running sshd all have to line up.

steps.label: systemctl status sshd
steps.sub: confirms the service is active, not just the port

steps.label: apt update && upgrade
steps.sub: refreshes the index and applies pending patches

steps.label: /var/log/auth.log
steps.sub: only your own login shows up, nothing unexpected
